entities.name: Arnold Luhaäär
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arnold Luhaäär was an Estonian heavyweight weightlifter. He competed in the 1928 and 1936 Olympic Games and won a silver and a bronze medal, respectively. He missed the 1932 games because Estonia could not afford sending a full team to Los Angeles during the Great Depression.
